The spearhead is modeled after an axe.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 13 |durability = 40 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Knight's Halberd}} Knight's Halberds are [[Weapon]]s that have been modeled after [[Axe]]s. They were used by [[Knight of Hyrule|Knights of Hyrule]] who were skilled in mounted combat before the [[Great Calamity]]. In the present, they are commonly used by low-tier [[Enemy|Enemies]] on the [[Tabantha Frontier]] and in the [[Gerudo Desert]]. Scanning the following [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]] has a chance to drop a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Knight's Halberd: * {{SSB}} Series [[Young Link]] amiibo * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo Being made of metal, Knight's Halberds will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They are also unable to be burned by a [[Fire]] or [[Scorching Climate]], and they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, Knight's Halberds will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Knight's Halberds belong to the [[Knight's Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons used by the Knights of Hyrule.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_003" |Life = 40 |Power = 13 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 7 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 45 |BuyingPrice = 180 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Spear |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Knight's Halberd}} {{Stub|TotK}} Knight's Halberds reappear in {{TotK|-}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:AoC Knight's Halberd Icon.png|Icon for the Knight's Halberd from {{AoC|-}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Decayed Weapon * Knight's Gear * Knight's Halberd✨ * Spear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Halberds, Knight's Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
